content: News 2026 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 2015 2014 2013 2012 2011 2010 2009 2008 2007 2006 2005 2004 2003 2002 2001 2000 &nbspPrevious Article Next Article Register for Special Webinar Celebrating PDB55 10/16 Register for a special encore presentation to celebrate PDB55 ' class='img-responsive' style=''> Register for a special encore presentation to celebrate PDB55 The wwPDB Foundation has partnered with the International Union of Crystallography to enable broadcasting (and on-demand streaming) of select presentations from the 2026 Triennial Congress, including the Plenary presentation from Cynthia Wolberger. Join us for From mechanism to inhibitors: Controlling deubiquitinating enzymes in cells ( abstract ) Cynthia Wolberger, Johns Hopkins University Tuesday, October 20, 2026 at 3pm ET | noon PT Please register for this free event. An institutional email address for registration is preferred. You will receive confirmation and a Zoom link by email before the event. Visit wwPDB.org for updates on other PDB55 events.
